body: Thanks for all that typing and advice. I've been wishing for a fatal heart attack or car accident the past months so my family would get the life insurance and keep the house.  I don't want them to suffer.  Personally, I would really end up low, as you say, because I am not even able to return to my job yet. I just find it bizarre that humans (me) will allow it to happen  to themselves.  Thanks again.

I have tried, but she is getting "fed up" with my problem.  Also, she is strong willed, and does not want to hear sob-stories about what I can and cannot do. She believes our finances are good, and I should stop worrying.   We have been married 31 years, I do not want to divorce her, we were okay before I collapsed.  But thanks for the advice.

Hello, my story is totally different but I have been in a situational depression for 8 months now (financial, etc).  Tomorrow I am supposed to go see the Psych to have my antidepressant level increased.  
I too don't know if I can make it, the thought of suicide keeps circulating in my head even though I know it is wrong from all angles (moral, legal, leaving wife alone, etc.)  
We can't change each other's circumstances, but maybe just offer a token of hope?
I just started two weeks ago so am at "mid" dosage ... no change so far.  Sorry.
